name: Mary's transdermal patch 1:1 THC:CBD
description: Mary’s award-winning transdermal patches are born out of a commitment to accurate dosing through an advanced delivery method. The discreet 2×2? squares simply adhere to any veinous part of the skin for 8-12 hours of unsurpassed systemic wellness benefits. Available in CBD, 1:1 CBD:THC, CBG, CBN, THCa, Indica and Sativa.
